paragraphs.text: Full-Stack Web Developer that is self-motivated, enthusiastic, and profit-oriented. Proven ability to

File Fish - An application that allows Aquarium personnel (water quality technicians) to track and
maintain the water parameters of any size Exhibit or System.
Core Responsibilities: Oversaw project development and timeline, Handlebars, CSS, front-
end routing, front-end JavaScript logic, and presenting the application.
Tools/Languages Used: HTML, CSS3, JavaScript, Express, Sequelize / MySQL, Node.js
runtime, Handlebars, Passport, and Heroku for deployment.
Project:  https://file-fish.herokuapp.com/ | Github:  https://github.com/JohnSasser/fileFish
Chipper - Designed to assist microchipped pet owners with updating personal and medical
information and preventing inaccurate/outdated vital information for pet reunification.
Core Responsibilities: Project Manager.
Tools/Languages Used: HTML, CSS3, Materialize, JavaScript, jQuery, Google Maps API,
and CSS Grid Layouts.
Project:  https://chippers-pets.herokuapp.com/ |  Github: https://github.com/JohnSasser/chipper
